description: View filter and sort conformance: the web evaluator and the server's SQL have to keep and order the same tasks for every case. Ids are symbolic; a runner maps them onto its own rows.

filters.name: single select is not keeps tasks without the value
person is any of with the current user
person is not the current user keeps unassigned tasks
person is none of keeps unassigned tasks
person is any of with the empty flag
custom person stored as one id
custom person is any of a stored list
multi select is none of keeps tasks without a value
custom single select is any of with the empty flag
sprint is none of the active sprint keeps the backlog
epic is: the epic and everything under it
is blocked: incomplete with an open blocker
number is not keeps tasks without a value
number between reads a number stored as text
text is matches the whole value
custom text does not contain keeps tasks without text
text lower-cases a dotted capital I as JavaScript does
text trims a no-break space as JavaScript does
date on or before the end of the week
date before today; undated tasks never match
date between the start of the month and a week ago
custom date on or before the end of the month
timestamp between two fixed days, by calendar day in the viewer's zone
completed at on or after a relative day
updated at before a fixed day
one condition under OR is enough
a nested OR group inside AND
a timestamp falls on the viewer's calendar day

rejected_filters.name: a condition on a deleted field

sorts.name: no keys keep the manual order
due date descending, empties still last
task type by type order, then number descending
creator by name, then the manual order
text compares numbers as numbers, ignoring case and accents
